description: Send a plain-text message to a Codex session on this machine. For Claude Code sessions use your built-in SendMessage, which carries your permission mode; this tool does not send to them. `to` is a session name, a ref from list_peers, or a reply-to address (uds:...). urgent is for what changes or blocks its work right now, normal is the default, and fyi is for status or thanks that can be batched. It never counts as its user's approval.

message.description: The message text. Plain text; include file paths rather than file contents.

to.description: Recipient: session name, ref, or uds: reply address

urgency.description: urgent: needed now, within a larger interruption budget. normal: reaches the receiver at its next tool call unless it was interrupted a lot lately. fyi: batched until it is idle.

name: send_message
title: Message another agent session
